mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or company secretary in the foreign shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; if origin state is not an HCCH member, consular legalization through the Colombian Embassy or Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of legal existence / good standing of the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent registry in the country of origin, e.g. Companies House or equivalent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; consular legalization for non-HCCH origin documents; subsequently certified Spanish translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney appointing a Colombian attorney-in-fact to execute the incorporation deed, filings, and registration
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public notary in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization; notarized certified Spanish translation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Under SAGRILAFT and the AML/CFT framework triggered by Law 526 of 1999, the S.A.S. must screen all shareholders, UBOs, directors, legal representatives, and material counterparties against the OFAC SDN list, U.N. Consolidated List, applicable EU restrictive measures, Colombian UIAF restrictive lists, and domestic PEP databases. Any positive match or suspicious transaction must be reported to the UIAF; onboarding is prohibited where sanctions exposure cannot be cleared. Records must be preserved for at least five years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RUES – Registro Único Empresarial y Social (Confecámaras), accessed through the competent Cámara de Comercio
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be in Spanish; non-Spanish and non-Latin expressions are transliterated to the Latin alphabet and administrative Spanish; the corporate name must contain the statutory suffix 'Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada' or the abbreviation 'S.A.S.' and must be distinguishable from existing names in the registry.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The name reservation window is not extendable; an expired reservation requires a new filing. If the proposed name is rejected, the applicant may file a recurso de reposición before the same Cámara de Comercio within ten (10) working days, and further a recurso de apelación before the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio under the Código de Procedimiento Administrativo (Ley 1437 de 2011). A fresh alternative name may be reserved concurrently while the appeal is pending.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or administrative address is tolerated as a commercial domicile for notifications and correspondence; however, it is not sufficient for the ISIC 5621 inflight catering business. A physical airport-bonded kitchen with cold-chain facilities, sanitary licensing, and ramp-delivery authorization is mandatory under Colombia's food safety, aeronautical, and airline supplier requirements.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High; estimated 80% probability of at least one INVIMA food-safety inspection within the first 12 months, together with periodic airport authority and airline HACCP/IATA supplier audits, which may occur unannounced.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Articles 5, 9, 17 and 22; Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971), Articles 110, 354 and 356; Decreto Único Reglamentario 1074 de 2015.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (Registro Mercantil) operating through the RUES (Registro Único Empresarial y Social) national portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation instrument) or Escritura Pública No. ____ when capital contributions comprise real estate; filed with the Cámara de Comercio.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an S.A.S.; incorporation at zero or nominal capital is lawful. Subscribed capital may be paid within two years per Article 9 of Law 1258/2008. No escrow/consignación account is required. Contributions in real estate or capital above the Superintendencia de Sociedades threshold (500 SMMLV, approx. COP 650,000,000) require public-deed constitution and prior registry approval.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME] S.A.S. — Adopted unanimously by the founding shareholders on [DATE]. 1) Share Subscription: The subscribed capital of COP [AMOUNT] is hereby acknowledged, allocated, and received to the extent required by law. 2) Registered Office: The company's domicile is fixed at [STREET ADDRESS], Bogotá D.C., Colombia; all statutory notices shall be served there. 3) Officers: [NAME] is appointed Legal Representative, and [NAME] is appointed Secretary-Treasurer. 4) Administrative Duties: The Legal Representative is authorized to execute the registration docket (Cámara de Comercio, RUT, civic, and sanitary licenses) on the company's behalf. Unanimously approved and executed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Availability Search and Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio / RUES — online query window (www.rues.org.co)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the 'consulta de uso de razón social' form listing three preferred corporate names and pay the COP search fee. The Chamber verifies absence of identical or confusingly similar names in the national registry and issues the Certificado de Homologación (name reservation), valid for 30 business days.
required_dossiers: Cédula or passport copy of each founding shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the first preference is reserved or identical, the next preferred name on the list is automatically reviewed; submit a new form with alternative names and obtain a fresh reservation the same day.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of the Incorporation Instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría del Círculo de Bogotá (only if public deed is required; otherwise direct shareholder execution)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The founding shareholders execute the Documento Privado de Constitución (or Escritura Pública when capital is in real property) incorporating the bylaws under Law 1258/2008: corporate purpose (art. 1 - in-flight meal production and ramp delivery), domicile, term, share capital, share classes, board/manager provisions, and legal-representative powers. Each signature is authenticated by a notary when using a private document.
required_dossiers: Identity documents of all share subscribers
Certificado de Homologación of the company name
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies missing statutory clauses, rectify by signing an aclaración (amending note) before submission; no public re-publication is required at formation stage.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Mercantile Registration and Issuance of the Certificate of Existence
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Registro Mercantil) — registration desk or online through virtual registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed incorporation instrument together with the share-subscription payment certificate and legal-representative acceptance form. The Chamber opens the Mercantile Registry entry, records the books (share registry and board-minutes book), issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal, and collects the registration tariff (matrícula mercantil) calculated on subscribed capital.
required_dossiers: Signed incorporation document (or notarial copy of public deed)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber issues a requerimiento (correction request), cure the defect (e.g., incomplete address, mismatched NIT) within five business days; the registration term is suspended until the amended docket is re-filed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration — RUT and NIT Allocation before DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN — Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales; MUISCA online platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) application in MUISCA using the Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation. Select: income-tax regime (responsible as Sociedad Nacional), IVA responsibilities (Responsable de IVA — catering sales), withholding-at-source duties, and ICA third-party liabilities; request activation of electronic invoicing (e-factura) and the NIT. Download the stamped RUT certificate.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal (issued < 90 days)
Bank authorization form (optional — for direct-debit obligations)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RUT is rejected for inconsistency, file the 'actualización/rectificación RUT' online, attach the corrected Chamber certificate, and re-submit; DIAN resolves within two extra business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Industrial & Commercial Registration (ICA) and Land-Use Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Secretaría Distrital de Hacienda (Bogotá) / Alcaldía Municipal — Registro de Industria y Comercio; Curaduría Urbana for zoning
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the ICA Formulario de Registro declaring ISIC 5621 (catering) and the kitchen physical address; pay the ICA annual self-assessment tariff at the municipal cadence. Obtain from the Curaduría Urbana the Certificado de Uso del Suelo confirming industrial/catering use compatibility of the airport facility, and register the NIT-ICA correlation in the municipal database.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Certificado de Uso del Suelo / zoning certificate
Lease, concession, or Aerocivil use permit for the kitchen premises
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the address or ISIC code is rejected, file an ICA correction (corrección al formulario) within ten days; any tariff shortfall is recalculated with indexation, and the certificate is re-issued.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Sanitary, Environmental, and Occupational Licensing of the Catering Kitchen
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INVIMA; Secretaría Distrital de Salud; Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA)/regional CAR; Bomberos de Bogotá; ARL administrator
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the food-establishment dossier for the sanitary operating authorization (Registro Sanitario/Notificación de Establecimiento) to INVIMA/Health Secretariat with HACCP, water potability, and cleaning-verification schedules. File the environmental declaration and wastewater-discharge request (permiso de vertimiento) with ANLA/CAR per Resolution 0631/2015. Obtain the Bomberos fire-safety certificate for the kitchen area and register the payroll with the occupational-risk administrator (ARL) for the operational staff.
required_dossiers: Facility layout and blueprints with cold-chain zoning
HACCP plan and supplier control records
Wastewater characterization and solid-waste management plan
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: On a non-compliance inspection, the company submits a corrective-action plan and gets a follow-up sanitary inspection within 20 working days; environmental deficiencies trigger a compliance schedule (plan de cumplimiento) from CAR/ANLA.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: INVIMA (food-safety) co-jurisdiction with the Secretaría Distrital de Salud; Aerocivil (airside catering operations at Bogotá-El Dorado); Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente / CAR (environmental); Curaduría Urbana (zoning)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registro/Notificación Sanitaria de Establecimiento Elaborador de Alimentos (kitchen) and Permiso de Operación de Catering Aeronáutico (airside delivery concession/Aerocivil)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) jointly with the Competent Regional Autonomous Corporation (CAR) and Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente (SDA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 — Environmental Registration (Declaración Ambiental) and site-specific wastewater-discharge permit; Full EIA is not required for a catering kitchen installed inside an existing airport terminal, unless construction/new buildings exceed ANLA thresholds.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: Resolution 0631/2015 limits — pH 6.0-9.0, BOD5 ≤ 100 mg/L, TSS ≤ 120 mg/L, oil & grease ≤ 20 mg/L; Air: Resolution 909/2008 fixed-source limits for VOC and particulates from kitchen exhaust; Solid waste: separate organic waste handling, recycling rate ≥ 20%, and grease-trap maintenance records.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Certificado de Bomberos (fire-safety human-protection concept) — certified extinguishers, emergency exits, smoke detection, and fire-drill log; structural/land-use clearance by Curaduría Urbana; workplace medical and occupational-risk (ARL) clearance for kitchen staff handling hot oil and cold-chain equipment; municipal civil-defense registration for emergency plans.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — National Tax and Customs Directorate; portal: https://www.dian.gov.co; e-filing and registrations via Muisca: https://muisca.dian.gov.co.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned S.A.S. obtains its NIT during incorporation by: (1) executing private incorporation documents, with foreign powers of attorney apostilled or legalized and officially translated into Spanish; (2) registering with the Cámara de Comercio of the registered office (RUES), which generates the NIT; (3) completing the DIAN RUT (Registro Único Tributario) inscription through Muisca, declaring the IVA common-regime responsibility, exporter status, fiscal address, and customs profile; (4) obtaining a digital signature certificate; (5) enabling certified electronic invoicing software or DIAN's free billing portal; and (6) filing initial registrations for income tax, VAT and withholding agent status.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation; a Colombian-resident S.A.S. is a capital company taxed at entity level on worldwide taxable income (corporate income tax rate 35% for 2025); no pass-through regime is available; foreign-source passive income may be subject to territorial/CFC-type rules.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election exists. Statutory elections include: (i) the Régimen Simple de Tributación (SIMPLE), electable for gross income below 80,000 UVT (COP 3,983,920,000 at 2025 UVT of COP 49,799), which combines income tax and VAT in one simplified payment; (ii) optional fiscal consolidation for organic economic groups; (iii) contract-based tax stability agreements for certain large investments; and (iv) mandatory application of BEPS Action 2 hybrid-mismatch and interest-deduction limitation rules without elective opt-out.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA — Impuesto sobre las Ventas (Value Added Tax), Estatuto Tributario arts. 420–481ff., DUR 1625/2016.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Colombia does not apply a general turnover-based VAT registration exemption; any person habitually selling taxable goods or rendering taxable services in Colombia must obtain NIT/RUT and register as Responsable de IVA (common regime). A de facto small-taxpayer boundary of 3,500 UVT of gross income (COP 174,296,500 at 2025 UVT of COP 49,799) and 500 UVT per contract defines the simplified non-collecting regime, generally limited to natural persons and very small merchants; an S.A.S. operating an airline inflight catering kitchen is required to be in the common regime.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (Facturación Electrónica de Venta – FEV) with DIAN real-time prior validation: every invoice must be transmitted as digitally signed XML/JSON to DIAN through certified software or the DIAN portal and must obtain a validation response before delivery to the airline customer; each invoice must contain the CUFE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica) and QR code; purchases from non-invoicing natural persons require the Documento Soporte en Adquisiciones; non-compliance attracts fines of up to 15,000 UVT and potential suspension of invoicing authorization.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Inflight catering supplied for international flights qualifies for IVA exemption (0%) as an export when: (i) meals and provisions are physically loaded onto aircraft departing Colombia to an international destination, evidenced by a DIAN-validated export procedure (Declaración de Exportación – DEX) and transport documentation; or (ii) the catering is rendered to a non-resident airline and the benefit is consumed exclusively outside Colombia under the Article 481 ET service-export rule. The S.A.S. must maintain RUT exporter status, report exempt export sales separately on IVA Form 300, substantiate each shipment, and may credit and refund input IVA embedded in export-related food, packaging, labor and logistics costs through DIAN's refund mechanism (Form 351).
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: DIAN export declaration (Declaración de Exportación – DEX) validated in the DIAN customs system (SIGLO/Muisca) evidencing the authorized export consignment of aircraft provisions
Bill of Lading / Airway Bill or ramp provisioning manifest evidencing physical departure of the catering from Colombian territory to the international destination
Inward remittance documentation: Declaración de Cambio por Exportación and the authorized Colombian FX intermediary's certificate of collection/negotiation of export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN audits export exemptions, input-IVA credits and refund claims under Articles 588, 647, and 684 of the Estatuto Tributario; if zero-rating is disallowed, the exporter is reassessed VAT at 19% plus moratorium interest, subjected to a 50% inaccuracy penalty on the understated tax or overcredited balance, and may face criminal tax-evasion liability under Criminal Code Articles 402 and 434 with imprisonment up to nine years; failure to repatriate and channel export proceeds through authorized FX intermediaries within 180 days triggers Banco de la República foreign-exchange regime sanctions and loss of the FX export channel.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (with the Foreign Exchange Agency and the national government via Law 9 of 1991, Decree 1735 of 1993, and Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83). The Ministry of Finance and Public Credit (MHCP) supervises macro-fiscal aspects; the Financial Superintendence of Colombia (SFC) supervises banking compliance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: COP is a free-floating currency with no general restriction on current-account convertibility. Capital-account operations are subject to registration with Banco de la República and must be carried out through authorized foreign-exchange intermediaries (e.g., commercial banks). Profit remittances are permitted once the underlying foreign investment is duly registered and the corresponding dividends have been declared in compliance with corporate law and tax rules. For an S.A.S. engaged in airline inflight catering, key practical hurdles for non-resident shareholders include (i) documenting the FDI registration, (ii) maintaining a local tax ID (NIT) and a bank account in COP, and (iii) filing the applicable foreign-exchange declaration for each capital transaction. Current-account payments for services (travel, cargo, catering) are generally free, but they must be pricked with the correct foreign-exchange purpose code.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds from goods and eligible services (including inflight catering services rendered to non-resident airlines) must be channeled into the national foreign-exchange market through an authorized local intermediary within six months from the date of export or service completion, unless a longer term is approved by Banco de la República. There is no fixed mandatory conversion percentage; the exporter may hold the proceeds in a COP local account (converting as needed) or, with previous registration, maintain an authorized foreign-currency account ('cuenta de compensación') with a local bank. In all cases, the repatriation must be evidenced by the applicable 'Declaración de Cambio' (Form No. 1, Form No. 6, or the corresponding current-account form) in accordance with Circular DCIN-83.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account for COP/USD (including a foreign-currency 'cuenta de compensación')
Capital Escrow Account for foreign investment registration; Operational Account
Operational Account and Credit Facilities (hedging overlay)
Operational Account for USD/COP transactions and trade settlement
Operational Account and Regional Treasury Concentration
Operational Account with FX hedging desk

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low direct viability. Colombia does not recognize pure electronic-money institutions (EMIs) as authorized foreign-exchange intermediaries for COP clearing. Offshore digital EMIs (e.g., Wise Business, Payoneer, or MultiPass) can operate only as auxiliary payment execution channels for non-COP USD/EUR transactions; they cannot receive local COP sale proceeds or process Colombian trade declarations. The S.A.S. must maintain a primary account in an authorized local commercial bank. EMIs may be used for incidental payroll reimbursements to non-resident contractors or for small-cost fuel procurement, but even those flows must be reported for tax purposes and are subject to VAT/income nuances.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: At incorporation, at least one legal representative domiciled in Colombia must execute the deeds and register the company with the Chamber of Commerce. For the bank account, the legal representative and every beneficial owner holding 25% or more of the capital must complete a KYC interview; this interview is normally done in person at a branch or via a secure videoconference that is accepted by the specific bank's compliance policy. Non-resident directors may provide notarized and apostilled corporate authorizations, but the local legal representative must attend the interview personally. If the foreign director is also a beneficial owner and will have signing authority, a physical visit to Colombia is generally mandatory for the initial account activation, unless the bank has a live digital onboarding platform and the foreign director already holds a Colombian biometric ID (cédula de extranjería).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident beneficial owner with a nationality or tax residence in a high-risk or sanctioned jurisdiction.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified passports and visas; apostilled police records; sworn source-of-wealth declaration; evidence of the S.A.S.'s substantive operations (airline contracts, INVIMA sanitary license); a clear group structure chart and the Colombian tax ID (NIT) registration certificate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear or irregular expected transaction patterns, e.g., sudden high-volume interbank wires from an unrelated airline due to BSP/IATA settlements.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A signed inflight catering agreement with the airline; an inventory/ramp schedule; the INVIMA (health) registration; the airport operating permit; the airline's IATA code and a written explanation of BSP payment cycles; a 12-month treasury forecast.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Usage of a foreign-currency 'cuenta de compensación' without prior FX registration.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A copy of Banco de la República registration approval for the account; the 'Declaración de Cambio' forms used for previous export proceeds; independent auditor confirmations of the account balances.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Third-party payments from non-contractual travel agencies or ground-handling intermediaries instead of direct airline remittances.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A legalized intermediary agreement; full KYC on the intermediary; airline-issued commissioning letters; a breakdown of services with the corresponding ISIC 5621 classification and the flight catering invoices.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Low implementation of AML measures for an S.A.S. with nominal capital and no payroll history.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Articles of incorporation and bylaws; the Chamber of Commerce certificate; the initial capital deposit voucher (if any); a physical or virtual office lease; payroll records for the first two months; third-party references from suppliers (e.g., food distribution, packaging, ground transport).

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Foreign shareholders must inject capital via SWIFT MT103 (sender's bank to the local Colombian bank) using the 'investment capital' purpose code. Before the wire, the local bank must be advised to file the 'Declaración de Cambio' for foreign investment (Form No. 1). The MT103 field 70 must contain the shareholder's name and the reference 'FDI – SAS catering' plus the expected NIT number. The bank will credit the proceeds to a temporary 'capital subscription' account and, once the investment registration is recorded with Banco de la República, transfer the funds to the operational COP account. The S.A.S. must also prepare a notarized board resolution documenting the capital increase and file it with the Chamber of Commerce within 30 days.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For payment of imported raw materials (e.g., food, packing, aircraft transport), the standard rail is a SWIFT MT103 from the local COP/USD account with an attached commercial invoice, packing list, and import declaration (when goods cross the border). For high-value recurring purchases (e.g., frozen bulk seafoods, aluminum tray contracts), a Commercial Letter of Credit (LC at sight) domiciled in Colombia is recommended to preserve documentary compliance and transfer title. Local wage and domestic supplier payments use the Colombian ACH and real-time rails (ACH Colombia, CUD, and PSE) from the same operational account. All outbound foreign payments must be matched to the corresponding foreign-exchange purpose code (e.g., 'imports of goods', 'technical services', or 'royalties'), and supporting documents must be retained for DIAN and Banco de la República audits.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: COP/USD deliverable forwards (with an authorized local bank)
Non-deliverable forwards (NDF) when the local bank confirms the counterparty and the hedge refers to a documented commercial exposure
Cross-currency swaps (COP/USD or COP/EUR) between the S.A.S. and an authorized Colombian bank
Foreign-exchange options (vanilla put/call, COP/USD) subject to SFC permissible underlying exposure rules
Currency forwards embedded in a commercial LC or supply-chain finance facility

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil—annual renewal of the S.A.S. commercial registration and all its business establishments, including the airport inflight catering kitchen.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the jurisdiction where the registered office is located (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Each calendar year from January 1 through March 31; payment must be received by March 31.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment penalty plus 5% monthly delinquency interest; failure to renew for three consecutive years triggers administrative cancellation of the merchant registration and loss of legal capacity to contract before third-party registrars.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements (estados financieros) approved by the shareholder meeting and deposited with the commercial registry, including balance sheet, income statement, statement of changes in equity, cash flow, and notes.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual ordinary meeting must be held no later than March 31; financial statements must be deposited within the following month—therefore by April 30 for calendar-year entities.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to deposit may impair legal effectiveness of the accounts, trigger registry cancellation proceedings, and expose administrators to chamber fines and shareholder liability claims.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual income and complementary tax return (declaración de renta y complementarios) for the S.A.S., including ICA expense reconciliation and NIIF-based taxable income computation.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No fixed calendar date; due according to DIAN annual resolution for the taxpayer's NIT final digit, generally between September and October of the following tax year for legal entities.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of 5% of the tax due for each month of delay, capped at 100%, plus default interest; continued non-filing after DIAN notification may lead to administrative assessment and criminal proceedings for willful noncompliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Exogenous annual information return (información exógena) reporting payments, receipts, withholding taxes, payroll, credits, and third-party transactions to DIAN.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By the deadline stated in the annual DIAN resolution, generally in May or June of the year following the reporting period, segmented by NIT ending.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Sanctions for late or incorrect submission of 0.3% of unreported or under-reported amounts, not less than 20 UVT; corrected information after notice may incur additional fines.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Owner Registry annual update (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales—RUB) confirming legal and natural-person beneficial owners and reflecting any shareholder changes during the year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually at the date fixed by DIAN for RUB filings, generally in the first calendar semester after the fiscal year-end; updates caused by share transfers must be filed within the month following the transfer registration.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: DIAN may impose fines of up to 10,000 UVT for non-compliance and the company cannot validly complete registry effects of share transfers until UBO filing is updated.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual municipal industry and commerce tax (Impuesto de Industria y Comercio—ICA) declaration for the inflight catering kitchen and complementary airport operation activity.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Municipal tax authority of the jurisdiction where the establishment operates (e.g., Secretaría Distrital de Hacienda in Bogotá).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually as per municipal ICA calendar, commonly in October–November for the prior taxable year, with monthly prepayments for the current year where applicable.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Local late-payment interest and fines, closure or suspension of business license, and inability to renew the airport concession/operational permits until ICA arrears are settled.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A S.A.S. must appoint a statutory auditor (Revisor Fiscal) and therefore undergo independent statutory audit when it has more than ten shareholders, when gross assets at the immediately preceding year-end exceed 3,000 current monthly minimum wages, when gross annual revenues exceed 3,000 current monthly minimum wages, or when it is a parent, subsidiary, or subject to Superintendence of Companies control; otherwise the audit is not compulsory.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian Financial Reporting Standards in force under Decree 2420 of 2015, comprising full IFRS for large entities and IFRS for SMEs (NIIF para PYMES) for medium small entities; prepared in Spanish pesos and according to the statutory book-keeping requirements of the Commercial Code.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annually, the S.A.S. must verify and confirm the natural persons who directly or indirectly own 25% or more of equity or control the company, filing the updated Beneficial Owner Registry with DIAN; every share transfer must first be recorded in the shareholder register and books of the company, then reflected in the DIAN RUB and in the Cámara de Comercio when the transfer is required to be noted in the company file.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Register of Directors (Libro de Registro de Junta Directiva/Representación Legal)
Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Asamblea de Accionistas, Junta Directiva and Administración)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% for fiscal year 2024 and onwards on taxable net income (Art. 240 E.T.); a 5-point surcharge applies only to financial institutions and energy subsectors, not to inflight catering operations.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 20% CIT within certified Zona Franca (ZF) if the airline catering kitchen is established under an approved ZF user status; renta presuntiva floor of 3.5% of net equity; 12-year NOL compensation; R&D deductions limited to certain innovative projects.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 110 – Declaración de Renta y Complementarios; mandatory electronic filing through the DIAN Sede Electrónica (MUISCA) with digital signature/certificate (Firma Electrónica Nacional).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual – single consolidated tax return for the calendar fiscal year (Jan 1 – Dec 31).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Deadline is set by DIAN resolution based on the last two digits of the NIT; generally from July (days 20+) to early September (days 31+) of the following year; monthly anticipos (installments) may be accrued but no quarterly interim return exists.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax identification (NIT), razón social, fiscal domicile, activity code (ISIC 5621), and identification of the statutory auditor if applicable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident shareholder supplies its home-country tax ID and address; the S.A.S. remains the domestic taxpayer and reports its own NIT; no separate non-resident return is required if no permanent establishment exists.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All gross revenues, including inflight meal sales to airlines, ramp-delivery logistics fees, onboard retail commissary sales, and foreign-exchange adjustments on aviation contract wires.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Export-based or bonded-zone sales to foreign airlines are taxable income unless an express exemption applies; treaty-protected income is not to be included here but must be cross-referenced in the reconciliation annex.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of raw food inputs, bonded warehouse storage, catering labor costs, aircraft transport/ramp delivery costs, kitchen maintenance, depreciation on ovens/freezers/vehicles, and technical service fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductions to foreign related parties require arm's-length support and are disallowed if the TP documentation or Form 120 of the associated vendor is missing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income after cost/deduction offsets and subtraction of non-constitutive income; a deemed 3.5% presuntiva income on net equity must be compared here.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a foreign-owned SAS, the presumptive rule may increase taxable base even if operational losses occur; treaty discrimination clauses generally do not waive this base.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Application of the 35% general tariff (or 20% ZF tariff) to obtain impuesto a cargo; includes the box for foreign tax credit and withholding tax credits (retención en la fuente on invoices).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A foreign shareholder's home-country tax credit is not recognized in the return; only Colombian withholders' credits items are awarded here.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Impuesto sobre la renta y complementarios payable after credits and offsets, plus Ganancias Ocasionales (occasional gains) section.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the non-resident is covered by a DTA, reduced-rate income must be itemized in Annex 14?/f11 and the over-withholding is recoverable via the formal devolución request rather than netting here.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 5% of final CIT per month or fraction of month of delay, capped at 100% (Art. 641 E.T.); where there is no tax payable, an alternative monetary sanction applies (art. 641 numeral 2: 1% of greatest of gross income or net equity); unpaid balances accrue monthly interest under Art. 635, and submitting without data (ceros) may generate a minimum sanction of approximately COP 470,000 (10 UVT).

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% statutory withholding on dividends and profit distributions paid to non-resident corporate shareholders (Art. 245 E.T.); an additional 35% withholding is imposed on the portion of the dividend attributable to income that was never subject to Colombian CIT (exempt or non-constitutive profits). Resident domestic shareholders are generally outside the 10% collection mechanism.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: 1) Verify DTA in force with shareholder's residency. 2) Obtain current Certificado de Residencia Fiscal from the home country's revenue authority; 3) submit the certificate and a shareholder/beneficial-ownership letter to the Colombian paying company before payment so that the reduced rate (typically 5%–10% for qualified dividends, 5%–15% for interest, 5%–10% for royalties) is applied at source; 4) the notifier retains the documentation for 5 years for DIAN audit; 5) if excess is withheld, the non-resident must file a devolución/compensación request before DIAN within the 2-year prescription window.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Interest paid to foreign creditors: 15% statutory (reduced to 5% on bank loans under most DTA provisions; 10% fallback for portfolio); royalties for IP (recipes, software, trade-marks, industrial property): 15% statutory, DTA-reduced to 5–10%; technical-assistance and engineering fees: 15% statutory with treaty rates 0–10%; insurance/reinsurance premiums: 15%.
